term.label: transcription_regulatory_region

definition.text: A regulatory region that is involved in the control of the process of transcription.

comments: Obsoleted by David Sant on 11 Feb 2021 when it was merged with transcriptional_cis_regulatory_region (SO:0001055) to reduce redundancy and be consistent with Gene Ontology. See GitHub Issue #527.
